Neutral creep and Roshan rows from reference map 6.88g (UnitBalance, UnitWeapons, UnitData), applied by scripts/apply-creeps-688g.py.
Scale as heroes_688g.tsv: spd milli per tick, range and sight milli, period ticks (cool1 x 16), damage (dmgplus1 + dice1 x (sides1 + 1) / 2), regen_milli (regenHP x 62.5).

Blank armor or radius: the 6.88g row has no value; the current unit keeps its value. Armor 0 on a neutral row is the stock WC3 value: the map SLK and unit.ini hold no def for it, so the unit keeps its stock base-object value (w3x2lni prebuilt unit.ini).
